moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off
moments.blurb: The twin music festivals, Reading and Leeds, return for the August Bank Holiday weekend, running from August 27th to 30th, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Kasabian.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Who are you seeing at Reading or Leeds this weekend? The festivals kick off on Thursday with a massive line-up across both sites!

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, Florence + The Machine – just some of the huge names hitting Reading and Leeds this Bank Holiday. Which stage are you heading for first?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: No plans for the Bank Holiday? Reading & Leeds Festivals are ON! Tune in for festival vibes all week.

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival returns
moments.blurb: London's iconic Notting Hill Carnival, Europe's largest street party, is set to take over the streets of West London from August 29th to 31st, celebrating Caribbean culture with music, parades, and food.

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: Notting Hill Carnival is just days away! Get ready for the biggest street party in Europe this Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Party Vibes
angles.copy: Steel bands, soca, calypso, reggae, drum 'n' bass – Notting Hill Carnival has it all. What's your favourite carnival sound?

moments.title: BBC Proms: Bond and Beyond
moments.blurb: The BBC Proms continues today at the Royal Albert Hall with 'Bond and Beyond', a performance featuring music from James Bond films and other cinematic spy thrillers.

angles.name: Tonight at the Proms
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! The BBC Proms presents 'Bond and Beyond' tonight at the Royal Albert Hall. What's your favourite Bond theme?

angles.name: Cinematic Sounds
angles.copy: From 007 to spy thrillers, the Proms celebrate iconic cinematic scores today. Perfect evening for film buffs!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean remains at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 21st to 27th, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong on the Official UK Singles Chart. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: New Music Monday
angles.copy: Your Official UK Singles Chart Top 5: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean, Shakira & Burna Boy, Ella Langley, Hugel/Imael Angel/Ultra Nate, and Stella Lefty. Which one's on repeat for you?

moments.title: Exeter's RAMM faces closure risk
moments.blurb: Exeter's Royal Albert Memorial Museum (RAMM) is at risk of closure due to failing heating systems, with an extraordinary council meeting today to discuss £260,000 in emergency funding.

angles.name: Save RAMM
angles.copy: Urgent meeting today for Exeter's RAMM as it faces closure due to boiler failure. Can the council secure its future? #SaveRAMM

angles.name: Local Heritage
angles.copy: Exeter's award-winning Royal Albert Memorial Museum is in crisis. What does RAMM mean to you?

moments.title: Exeter receives £2m for homelessness
moments.blurb: Exeter is set to receive nearly £2 million in government funding to tackle rough sleeping, aiming to provide settled homes and support for those experiencing long-term homelessness.

angles.name: Homelessness Support
angles.copy: Good news for Exeter: almost £2 million secured to tackle rough sleeping. A step towards ensuring everyone has a home. #ExeterSupport

angles.name: Community Impact
angles.copy: How will Exeter's £2 million funding for rough sleeping make a difference in our community? Share your thoughts.
